lines.zh: 深海里只有我自己的水声。
lines.en: Only my own wake moves in the deep.
I swim forward with my mouth open.
Tooth grinds on tooth, a rasping sound.
The pressure pushes me down low.

lines.zh: 光到不了这么深的地方。
lines.en: Light does not reach this depth.
I follow the trench along the seafloor.

lines.zh: 深海的鱼见我掉头就走。
lines.en: Deep fish turn away when I pass.
My bite closes on nothing, not even water.
I patrol this black water alone.
My jaws snap and my head rings.
The sand of the bottom is soft and cold.
I circle a stone that sank long ago.
Something overhead, too far to reach.
I head down into still deeper water.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里转了个弯，牙还在响。
lines.en: I turn in the dark, teeth still clicking.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟的墙慢慢游，不问方向。
lines.en: I follow the trench wall slowly, no direction in mind.

lines.zh: 我悬在黑暗里，慢慢磨牙。
lines.en: I hang in the dark, grinding my teeth.

lines.zh: 深海静得能听见骨头响。
lines.en: The deep is quiet enough to hear bone.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴等东西撞进来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open for whatever comes.
The pressure sits heavy on my eyes.
Daylight has never reached this depth.
I bite a mouthful of water.
A small stone sinks past me.
My teeth never ache.

lines.zh: 那些骨头早就啃干净了。
lines.en: Those bones were cleaned long ago.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，什么也没有。
lines.en: I turn half around; there is nothing.
Only my breathing moves in the black.
I wait for a fish to lose its way.
My jaw clicks softly to itself.
The deeper I go, the quieter it is.
You have dived very deep.
I watch your lamp from the dark.
Your light makes my teeth shine.
You should not come this deep.

lines.zh: 我把整个头骨转向你的灯。
lines.en: I swing my whole skull toward your lamp.
You smell of bone to me.
I open my mouth so you can see.
You have stopped; good.
My eyes do not blink in the dark.
You are less than three lengths away.
Which fool dares sink teeth in me?
My teeth clacked on something hard.
Blood seeps out behind my gills.
I turn and open my mouth wide.
My head rings from the strike.
I back into the deeper trench.
My jaw has come out of line.
It hurts to the bone; I stay silent.
It bit a piece of my fin off.
I flee slowly, and it shames me.
What is that? Bone?
I smell blood and my teeth itch.
Is that meat in your hand?
I swim slowly toward your side.
Give it here; I do not care raw or cooked.
My jaws are already moving.
One length nearer and it is mine.
Food is never common this deep.
You have raised it out of reach.
I circle that small thread of scent.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的牙磕响了。
lines.en: You hit me and my teeth clack.
My side brushes along your leg.
There is no room to dodge down here.
Your shove rolls me through the water.
We churn the water black.
My fin scraped you; my mistake.
Move back so I can swim.
That knock loosened my jaw.
We are too close, much too close.
I slowly make a path for you.

lines.zh: 这么深的地方，很少有谁。
lines.en: So deep, there is rarely anyone.
I follow another wake through the dark.
Her teeth are as blunt as mine.
We circle and hardly ever touch.
A companion comes slowly at this depth.
She nudges my flank with hers.

lines.zh: 我们一起磨牙，声音很响。
lines.en: Together we grind our teeth loudly.
She only grinds her teeth; I answer.
This black water is enough for us.
Perhaps one day there will be small teeth.

lines.zh: 你把我从深水里拽上来。
lines.en: You haul me up out of the deep.
The light is too much; I cannot see.
This bucket is too small for my jaws.
My jaw knocks against the wall.
The pressure up here is much too light.
I bite the rim of the bucket.
The air burns the back of my throat.
Put me back where it is black.
I grind my teeth so you hear.
What do you want with me?
Something is shifting on the seafloor.
It is faint, but the water tells me.

lines.zh: 我转向那道细小的震动。
lines.en: I turn toward that small vibration.
A fish, and it is alone.
My teeth move before I do.
It is still rooting through the sand.

lines.zh: 我伏在软沙上，等它再近些。
lines.en: I settle onto the soft bottom and let it near.
Across the black water, I take my time.
That shadow paused for a moment.
In the black, I see it first.
I am in no hurry; the deep has time.
When it moves, I take one inch.
I open my mouth to test the water.
It is squeezing into a rock crevice.
I block the mouth of the gap.
Its tail is still sticking out.
I open my jaws very slowly.
I wait for its shadow to shift.
My teeth are close to it now.
It has begun to panic.

lines.zh: 颌骨一合，什么都结束了。
lines.en: One snap of the jaw and it is over.
My teeth lodge in its bones.
Blood looks black at this depth.
It struggles twice and stops.
I crush it before I swallow.
The bones I cannot use I spit out.
My teeth sink in deep.
I have lost another tooth.
I chew it down to bone meal.
Full now, I sink slowly away.

lines.zh: 我在没有光的深处睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes where no light reaches.
The pressure is heavy; I am used to it.
There are no other fish near.
I grind my first set of teeth.
The seafloor sand is soft and cold.

lines.zh: 头顶极高处才有一点光。
lines.en: Far overhead there is a hint of light.
I swim off on my own.
There are bones here to gnaw.
My shadow on the sand is faint.
The abyss welcomes me.
Hot water pours into my gills; I thrash blind.

lines.zh: 我从水柱里掉下来，牙磕了。
lines.en: I drop from the current and crack a tooth.
I am in water and something grips my throat.
The shock throws me flat onto the seafloor.
Something pointed goes into my back.
That light rings inside my bones.
Too hungry to care, I gnaw the stone.
Electricity crawls through the water to my teeth.
There is not even water; I bite nothing.
